f.title: Use the ElViS electronic vigilance system for ICSR reporting (encouraged)
f.statement: Swissmedic encourages stakeholders to use the Electronic Vigilance System (ElViS), which allows reporting of ICSRs by direct data insert or by upload of XML files in a two-way process.
f.clause: 5 What is ElViS?

rows.quote:
Swissmedic has implemented a new adverse event reporting tool and encourages the stakeholders
to use the new Electronic Vigilance System, called ElViS, which allows the reporting of ICSR by
direct insert of data or by upload of xml files in a two-way process.
rows.location: 5 What is ElViS?
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Related to committed SMC-MU101-V5-0006 (ElViS or E2B gateway permitted); this row is the ElViS guide's own encouragement, not a duplicate. Double-check: below 90: 'encourages the stakeholders' mapped to MAH; Recommended is a reasonable but judgement-based reading of 'encourages'.

f.title: Choose either direct data insert or E2B file upload at registration, not both
f.statement: During registration, MAHs may choose between direct data insert or upload of E2B files; combining both options is not possible.
f.clause: 5 What is ElViS?
f.exceptions: The two options cannot be combined.

rows.quote:
During the registration process, interested MAHs have the option to choose between
 direct data insert, or
 upload of E2B files.
The combination of both options is not possible.
rows.location: 5 What is ElViS?
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: below 90: 'have the option' read as Permitted; the no-combination rule is descriptive ('is not possible').

f.title: CIOMS form and backing form no longer required with ElViS
f.statement: For both ElViS options (direct insert or upload), submission of the CIOMS form and of the backing form currently attached to any report is no longer required.
f.clause: 5 What is ElViS?

rows.quote:
For both options the submission of the CIOMS form is no longer required, as well as the backing
form which is currently attached to any report.
rows.location: 5 What is ElViS?
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: below 90: relief ('no longer required') recorded as Permitted is a judgement-call level.

f.title: After electronic exchange is set up, use other reporting routes only by exception
f.statement: After the electronic exchange process between the MAH and Swissmedic has been set up, any other reporting route is accepted only as an exception.
f.clause: 5 What is ElViS?

rows.quote:
After the setup of the electronic exchange process between the MAH and Swissmedic, any other
reporting routes will only be accepted as an exception.
rows.location: 5 What is ElViS?
rows.review_note: Review: no change; Mandatory kept: other routes are accepted only as an exception once electronic exchange is set up. Double-check: below 90: 'will only be accepted as an exception' read as Mandatory is a judgement-call level.

f.title: Option to exchange attachments and case queries/answers through ElViS
f.statement: ElViS allows exchange of attached documents such as laboratory reports, X-rays or pictures regardless of format; queries and answers on submitted ICSRs are also exchanged through ElViS.
f.clause: 5 What is ElViS?

rows.quote:
ElViS allows the exchange of attached documents such as laboratory reports, X-rays, or pictures,
regardless of the format. Furthermore, queries and answers to submitted ICSR will also be
exchanged by ElViS.
rows.location: 5 What is ElViS?
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: below 90: descriptive 'allows' read as Permitted is a judgement-call level.

f.title: Option to submit free text and attachments in German, French or Italian
f.statement: ElViS forms are in English, but free text (e.g. narrative or sender comment) and attachments could also be submitted in German, French or Italian.
f.clause: 5 What is ElViS?

rows.quote:
ElViS forms are in English, but free text (e.g. narrative or sender comment) and attachments could
also be submitted in German, French or Italian.
rows.location: 5 What is ElViS?
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: below 90: 'could also be submitted' read as Permitted; minor judgement.

f.title: Register on the Swissmedic Portal and apply for an ElViS user account
f.statement: The MAH must be registered on the Swissmedic Portal; access is possible for all companies holding an establishment licence for the manufacture and distribution of medicinal products on the Swiss market. MAHs interested in ElViS are requested to fill out the application for a user account via the Swissmedic eGov portal registration page.
f.clause: 6 Conditions for the use of the Swissmedic Portal and ElViS
f.applicability: Companies holding an establishment licence for manufacture and distribution on the Swiss market

rows.quote:
The MAH must be registered on the Swissmedic Portal. The access is possible for all companies
holding an establishment licence for the manufacture and distribution of medicinal products on the
Swiss market. MAHs interested to use ElViS are requested to fill out the application for a user
account under
rows.location: 6 Conditions for the use of the Swissmedic Portal and ElViS
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Quote stops before the registration URL. Double-check: below 90: combines 'must be registered' with 'are requested to fill out'; quote stops before the registration URL.

f.title: Sign the ElViS user agreement to access the system
f.statement: MAHs interested in ElViS are requested to sign a user agreement to access the system.
f.clause: 6 Conditions for the use of the Swissmedic Portal and ElViS

rows.quote: and to sign a user agreement to access the system.

f.statement: Mozilla Firefox (at least version 24) and Microsoft Explorer (at least version 9) can be used.
f.clause: 6 Conditions for the use of the Swissmedic Portal and ElViS

f.title: Sign the Swissmedic Portal contract and delegate a Partner-Administrator
f.statement: In the MAH registration steps, after ISCS creates the contract for the Swissmedic Portal, the company signs the contract and delegates a Partner-Administrator, for whom ISCS creates the account.
f.clause: 6 Conditions for the use of the Swissmedic Portal and ElViS (steps for MAH registration)

2. ISCS (Informatik Service Center Swissmedic) creates contract for the Swissmedic-Portal
   3. Company signs the contract and delegates a Partner-Administrator

rows.review_note: Review: no change; Mandatory kept: the registration steps are conditions for access ('Conditions for the use'). Step 1 (web form) is covered by 0007; the quote omits its URL. Double-check: below 90: numbered registration step list without its lead-in; present tense, Mandatory is a judgement call.

f.title: Obtain a CH-LOGIN account and link it to ElViS with the eIAM onboarding code
f.statement: To use ElViS, a CH-LOGIN user account is needed to verify identity/authorisation; the user receives an e-mail with an onboarding code to associate the CH-LOGIN account with the applications released in the eIAM portal (such as ElViS).
f.clause: 6 Conditions for the use of the Swissmedic Portal and ElViS

rows.quote:
To use the ELVIS application, you will need
    A CH-LOGIN user account to verify your identity/authorisation
    You will receive an email with your onboarding code to associate your CH-LOGIN user
      account with the applications released in the eIAM portal (such as ELVIS)
rows.location: 6 Conditions for the use of the Swissmedic Portal and ElViS
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: below 90: 'you will need' read as Mandatory; addressed to the user rather than named MAH.

f.title: Log in with CH-Login and mTAN and accept the terms of use
f.statement: On the Swissmedic Portal the user must enter CH-Login data and then the mTAN code sent by SMS to the personal (or a dedicated) mobile phone. At first login and after software updates, the user must accept the displayed terms of use to continue.
f.clause: 6 Conditions for the use of the Swissmedic Portal and ElViS

rows.quote:
On this page, the
user is required to enter his CH-Login data (User account e-mail address and Password). Once
these are entered correctly, the user will each time receive an SMS with the mobile transaction
number (mTAN) on his personal cell phone (or a dedicated one). This numerical code must be
entered on the screen coming after.
At the first time users login, and also after software updates, the terms of use will be displayed during
the login process. The user needs to accept the terms of use in order to be able to continue.
rows.location: 6 Conditions for the use of the Swissmedic Portal and ElViS
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: below 90: quote starts 'On this page' without its lead-in; actor in source is the user, mapped to MAH.

f.title: Appoint two ElViS user administrators (administrator and deputy)
f.statement: The MAH has to appoint two user administrators (administrator and deputy). They are the primary contact persons within the company and are responsible for managing/administering all other users in the company (self-administration).
f.clause: 6 Conditions for the use of the Swissmedic Portal and ElViS

rows.quote:
Two User Administrators have to be appointed by the MAH (administrator and deputy). The user
administrators are the primary contact persons within the company, and are responsible to
manage/administrate all other users in the company (self administration).
rows.location: 6 Conditions for the use of the Swissmedic Portal and ElViS
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: confirmed against source; quote proves statement, level, actor and classification.

f.title: Conduct a compatibility test with Swissmedic before reporting by file upload
f.statement: If a company exchanges reports via file upload, a compatibility test must be conducted with Swissmedic before reporting starts: the company hands in an ICSR 2.1 XML file beforehand, which must comply with the EMA business rules.
f.clause: 6 Conditions for the use of the Swissmedic Portal and ElViS (also 5: compatibility testing before file upload)
f.systems: ElViS; ICH E2B(R2); EMA business rules

rows.deadline: Beforehand (before reporting by file upload starts)
rows.quote:
If a company decides to exchange the reports via file upload, a compatibility test needs to be
conducted with Swissmedic. To do so the company needs to hand in a ICSR 2.1 XML file
beforehand. The file needs to be compliant to the EMA Business rules.
rows.location: 6 Conditions for the use of the Swissmedic Portal and ElViS (also 5: compatibility testing before file upload)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Section 5 ('Before starting the reporting by file upload, compatibility testing has to be done') states the same duty and timing; not captured separately (one duty), named in location. Double-check: below 90: 'before reporting starts' timing comes from the section 5 sentence, not the quote (quote says 'beforehand' for the test file); deadline wording aligned to the quote.

f.title: Also test upload of Swissmedic XML files into the company system
f.statement: It is recommended that the company also performs compatibility testing on its side with the Swissmedic XML files, to ensure correct upload into its own system (if wanted).
f.clause: 6 Conditions for the use of the Swissmedic Portal and ElViS
f.processes: Validation & change control; Safety intake & collection

rows.quote:
It is recommended to do the
compatibility testing on the company side (with the Swissmedic XML files) as well to ensure the
correct upload into the own system (if wanted).
rows.location: 6 Conditions for the use of the Swissmedic Portal and ElViS
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: confirmed against source; quote proves statement, level, actor and classification.

f.title: Download ICSRs, acknowledgements and queries from ElViS before the 6-week retention ends
f.statement: ElViS is not a database but a reporting platform; all reports, including attachments and queries, are stored only for a limited period of 6 weeks. Each company is responsible for handling and administering reports (ICSRs, acknowledgements, etc.) by downloading all information locally to its own systems.
f.clause: 7 Short description of main ElViS functionalities
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Safety intake & collection; Submission operations

rows.quote:
ElViS is not a database, but a reporting platform to transmit and receive ADRs to and from
Swissmedic. All reports, including attachments and queries, are stored in the system during a limited
period of 6 weeks. It is the responsibility of each company to handle and administrate the reports
(ICSRs, acknowledgements, etc.) by downloading all information locally on its own systems.
rows.location: 7 Short description of main ElViS functionalities
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Deadline is the 6-week ElViS storage period stated in the quote. Double-check: below 90: 'It is the responsibility' read as Mandatory; the 6-week deadline is inferred from the storage period, not stated as a deadline.

f.title: Provide a unique e-mail address for ElViS confirmations
f.statement: ElViS confirms user actions automatically by e-mail; therefore a unique e-mail address is requested from the MAH.
f.clause: 7 Short description of main ElViS functionalities

rows.quote:
An automatic confirmation of different actions fulfilled by users is provided by email. Therefore a
unique email address is requested from the MAH.
rows.location: 7 Short description of main ElViS functionalities
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: below 90: 'is requested from the MAH' read as Mandatory is a judgement call.

f.title: Follow ICH content and format for safety and acknowledgement messages
f.statement: Safety and acknowledgement messages have to follow the content and format of the respective ICH guidelines.
f.clause: 7 Short description of main ElViS functionalities

rows.quote:
Safety and
acknowledgement messages have to follow the content and format of the respective ICH guidelines.
rows.location: 7 Short description of main ElViS functionalities

f.title: Code required ElViS fields in MedDRA using the company's own MedDRA browser
f.statement: MedDRA coding is required for some ElViS data fields (e.g. diagnoses, reactions or indications). Swissmedic does not provide a MedDRA pick-list; the user must insert MedDRA terms copied from its own MedDRA browser.
f.clause: 7 Short description of main ElViS functionalities

rows.quote:
MedDRA coding is required for some data fields in ElViS (e.g. diagnoses, reactions or indications).
Swissmedic will not provide the MAHs with a pull down or a popup displaying the MedDRA terms.
The user needs to insert the MedDRA terms copied from its own MedDRA browser.
rows.location: 7 Short description of main ElViS functionalities
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: confirmed against source; quote proves statement, level, actor and classification.

f.title: Contact the ElViS Hotline on transmission problems (missing or error ACK log)
f.statement: If case transmission problems arise (missing ACK log or an error code in the ACK log), the ElViS Hotline has to be contacted.
f.clause: 7 Short description of main ElViS functionalities (Contingency plan)

rows.quote:
If case transmission problems arise (missing or error code in the ACK-log), the ElViS Hotline has to
be contacted.
rows.location: 7 Short description of main ElViS functionalities (Contingency plan)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: confirmed against source; quote proves statement, level, actor and classification.

f.title: Submit cases the traditional way (backing form and CIOMS) if ElViS problems are not solved in reasonable time
f.statement: If the transmission problem cannot be solved within reasonable time, cases must be submitted the traditional way (backing form and CIOMS form).
f.clause: 7 Short description of main ElViS functionalities (Contingency plan)

f.title: Contact the ElViS Hotline for access or use problems
